description: Kill a session and forget the sessionId entirely. The shell process is terminated and the sessionId is *not* tombstoned — future calls against it will error with "Unknown sessionId". Use this when you're explicitly done with a session. Tombstones (which auto-respawn on next access) only happen for system-driven terminations: idle-kill, eviction, or shell exit.

sessionId.description: Numeric id from terminal_create or terminal_list.

name: terminal_destroy
title: Destroy terminal session
